answer_1.quote: We propose Parrot, which aims to facilitate the development of LLMs with stronger multi-turn instruction following capabilities... To quantitatively assess the ability of LLMs to follow long-turn instructions, we expand MT-Bench by manually annotating six additional follow-up questions, creating an eight-turn evaluation benchmark called MT-Bench++.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn assistant responses following user queries

answer_2.quote: We employ GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of model-generated outputs, assigning a score from 1 to 10 as the final result. ... We also use the Self‑Rouge metric to measure query diversity.

answer_3.quote: MT-Bench employs GPT-4 to evaluate the responses, assigning a score from 1 to 10 as the final result.

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 100 sessions from the Parrot-40K dataset, totaling 953 utterances, for human evaluation. The results indicate that 95.1% of the utterances are contextually relevant... We ask three annotators to score the quality of 500 utterances generated by Parrot‑Ask and baseline methods.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to assess the quality of each generated utterance, focusing on relevance and overall fluency.
